Name: Aimon's Small Forest Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][i][center][color=#fce5cd]A tidy and lively forest themed farm, with qql changes, tweaks and additions![/color][/center]
[/i][center][b][u]Big thanks to salami5164 (Discord) for commissioning me and encouraging to upload this farm mod here on nexus![/u][/b][/center]
[center]This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8192]Tiny Garden Farm[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14117]Tiny Wild Farm[/url]﻿, check them out if you want![/center][/size][center][size=3]----------------------------------
[b][i][u][color=#ffe599]Note: [/color][/u][/i]there's 2 versions of this mod - one adds new forest farm as custom one (does not affect vanilla Forest farm). Another one works as replacement for vanilla Forest farm.
If you start your save file anew - I suggest using 1st version of the mod for avoiding issues with other farm mods.[/b][/size][/center]
[u][u][size=3][b]Features:[/b][/size][/u]
[/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]More tidy and overgrown Foraging Farm map![/size]
[*][size=2]Custom starter giftbox items - (choose before starting new save file!)[/size]
[*][size=2]Ability to dig grass tiles[/size]
[*][size=2]Better fish catch pool - catch different types of fish depends on the water type.[/size]
[*][size=2]Respawnable hardwood stumps - 1 stump respawns every day in left down corner of the map (3 stumps in total)[/size]
[*][size=2]Warp to SVE Grandpha's Shed map[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Secret Woods and Cindersap Forest passages - adds warps to Secret Woods and Forest maps (the forest one will warp you to tile behing the big pink tree). warp to Secret Woods blocked by hardwood log, so you still need to get iron axe to access it.[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list][b][color=#fce5cd][center][size=3]This mod is for Stardew 1.6 only[/size][/center][/color][/b]
[size=3][b]Don't want respawnable stumps? Go to 
your "Mods" folder, open "Aimon's Small Forest Farm" and delete "[FTM] Small Forest Farm"

Don't want top and bottom ponds or want to remove small bridge to greenhouse? You can config all of it in mod's config! (Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url]for more convenient ingame config)[/b][/size]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]SVE Grandpha's Shed Warp - true/false[/size]
[*][size=2]Top Pond - true\false[/size]
[*][size=2]Bottom Pond - true\false[/size]
[*][size=2]Ground bridge to greenhoue - true\false[/size]
[/list][u][size=3][color=#ffe599][b]NOTE:[/b][/color] after changing config for ponds and bridge, there still be brook sounds in the ponds area - it will disappear after map reload (after you sleep for 1 day or reload your save file)
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]Starter Gift - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/size]
[*][size=2]Starter Giftbox items available: [/size]
﻿ [quote][size=2] ﻿﻿- Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿ ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/size][/quote][/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img]

[size=2][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible [/color][/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...
[b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with any recolors and retextures. 
[/size][size=2][color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with any other mod that edits the Foraging Farm (if you use Vanilla Farm replacement version)

[b][u][color=#ffe599]NOTE for SVE compatibility[/color][/u] - the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [color=#ffe599]x = 74, y = 9[/color] - change it in SVE config.[/b]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]
[*][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip "Aimon's Small Forest Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*]Enjoy.
[/list]

[size=4]----------------------------[/size][/center][size=4]
[/size][/size]
